income_calculation_rules.family_definition: Includes spouse, minor children, unmarried adult children, and dependent parents living together with no independent income.
income_calculation_rules.exclusions: Income of a widowed or abandoned woman in the family is NOT included in the family income calculation.

eligibility_criteria: Applicant or their family must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
No minimum or maximum family income limit applies to request the certificate.
Students applying for scholarships must apply using their parent/guardian's family income details.

Income Calculation Rules UP: Family income includes total annual income of spouse, minor/unmarried children, and dependent parents living together. EXCLUSION: Income of a widowed or abandoned woman in the family is NOT included in the family income. Verified in the field by Lekhpal (Rural) or Revenue Inspector (Urban).

Uttar Pradesh Revenue Department notification 565/1-9-2023-R-9 (18 April 2023) applies to income, caste, domicile and solvency certificates issued through eDistrict. It requires an applicant to furnish proof of possession of an Aadhaar number or undergo Aadhaar authentication. The notification does not specify OTP as the authentication method and does not state which profile fields are fetched.
